name: Xizang Tianlu Co., Ltd.
summary: Xizang Tianlu Co., Ltd. engages in general contracting business in China. It is involved in the general contracting of highway engineering construction, building, municipal public, railway engineering, power engineering, electromechanical engineering, and water conservancy and hydropower engineering construction works; professional contracting of bridge engineering, highway pavement construction, and road subgrade engineering works; and engineering contracting activities.
